name: San Antonio Missions
description: Strung along the San Antonio River in southern Texas, five stone mission complexes built by Franciscan friars in the 1700s still stand, along with a ranch about 37 kilometres south. Visitors can walk through churches, granaries, farmland and old irrigation channels. Church carvings blend Catholic symbols with nature-inspired Coahuiltecan designs, showing how Spanish and indigenous cultures met on this frontier.
